char_xiaohua.name: Daniel Xiao
char_xiaohua.info: Haunted house performer who died three years ago

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: October 31, 2025, 10:30 AM, Chaoye Park, Visitor Center

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Alright, let's go over the whole case from start to finish.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Three years ago, Chaoye Park set out to revamp its existing attractions, so it hired Celeste Ming, who was skilled at planning and writing, as the Performance Department supervisor.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Victor Jiang, the head of the performer team, had always believed he was better suited for the top role and strongly resented the arrival of the parachuted executive, Celeste Ming.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Celeste Ming, for his part, thought highly of himself. He did not gain a deep understanding of the performers or the practical realities of park operations, and when he rashly pushed several projects forward, he met resistance from every side.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: The leadership would not support him, and the staff would not listen. Yet even under those circumstances,  the Halloween haunted house—destined to become a visitor favorite—was born anyway.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: These three became the first performers for the project.

options.text: A Victor Jiang, Daniel Xiao, Sunny Chen
B Victor Jiang, Aiden Li, Sunny Chen
C Aiden Li, Daniel Xiao, Sunny Chen

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Afterward, Aiden Li, who had joined the park's props team and was helping out in the haunted house, also took part in early performance preparations and rehearsals with Victor's encouragement.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Just as everything was proceeding as planned, tragedy struck.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: On October 8, 2022, before Halloween, everyone was rehearsing the new performance project, "The Masque of the Red Death." At around four in the afternoon, this performer, who served as both actor and props staff, passed by performance Spot 5 and discovered the "Red Death" hanging crookedly from the beam.

options.reply: That doesn't seem right, does it?

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Aiden went into the haunted house, passed Spot 5, and found the "Red Death" hanging crookedly from the beam.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: But because of one thing, Aiden didn't panic at first.
introDialogue.autoPresent: Point out why Aiden Li did not panic

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Because everyone had previously tested hoisting the Red Death dummy, Aiden Li thought the thing hanging there was a prop and went forward to tidy it up, only to discover that the "Red Death" was not a mannequin, but his colleague Daniel Xiao, who had suffocated after the safety lock came loose and the rope wrapped around his neck.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: At the time, Aiden had just been brought into the performer team by Victor as a special exception. He looked up to Victor like an older brother, so he reported it to him right away.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Victor came to the scene and saw Daniel's body. He realized right away that if this was reported as a safety accident, he'd be held responsible—and the show would probably be delayed, maybe even canceled.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: He came up with a plan fast.

options.text: A Falsify the time of death
C Disguise the body as a suicide

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: That method was to have Aiden remove the safety buckle and wind the rope around the deceased's neck again, creating the appearance of suicide.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: After that, he loudly spread the story that Daniel Xiao had become dejected because Performance Department supervisor Celeste Ming had reprimanded him, making everyone think it was all Celeste Ming's fault.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Because Celeste Ming was believed at the time to be connected to harassment allegations, and because he had long been taking outside work, the park had already been dissatisfied with him. Using this incident, they privately made Celeste Ming resign of his own accord.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: As for the harassment, it was actually an accusation Sunny Chen had made against this person.

options.text: C Jasper Liu from Food & Beverage

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: After she mentioned the matter to Victor, Victor attacked Jasper Wang in a dark alley, and the latter resigned soon afterward.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Sunny was grateful for Victor's help. During that period, Victor was clearly opposed to Celeste Ming. Sunny's sympathies shifted toward Victor, and she deliberately did not clarify the truth in the post.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: After Celeste left, Victor didn't get the promotion he'd been waiting for. Instead, they brought in Ray Shi—a guy with connections. Their relationship was like this...

options.text: A They looked down on each other

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Ray never positioned himself against Victor. He knew the park really relied on these veteran employees to keep things running, so he respected Victor quite a bit.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: But with Ray, Victor couldn't pick a fight the way he had with Celeste. With Ray, it was like punching a pillow—he had all this force, but nowhere to land it.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: He could match an outside hire in skill, but he didn't have any relatives in high places to back him up or open doors for him.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Victor had gotten this far by doing things his own way—the way he trusted. But in the end, he still hit an invisible ceiling.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: So he started showing his impatience and his temper. And he'd never had a strong moral compass—manipulating people to get what he wanted just came naturally to him.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: When Aiden started pulling away, Victor hinted that Aiden had something to do with Daniel's death. And when that battery exploded, he convinced Faye that she'd caused a major accident.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: He only looked out for people who were loyal to him—and didn't hesitate to punish anyone who wasn't.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Beyond that, this incident also made him resent the visitors who came to the park.
introDialogue.autoPresent: Point out why Victor wanted revenge against the visitors.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: He decided to give them a taste of their own medicine—so he and Sunny started stealing visitors' stuff in the haunted house. Of course, they usually went after things people wouldn't notice right away.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Aiden grew more and more afraid of him—and he also found out what Victor and Sunny were up to.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: In the end, he came up with a plan—get his friend Anton to steal something valuable from a visitor inside the haunted house. He hoped the park would catch on and expose Victor and the others, even if it meant all of them getting fired. Aiden just couldn't keep going like that.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: On the night after the theft, Anton learned from Aiden that Victor was dead, so he placed the stolen phone somewhere they would be easier to find. During our earlier interrogation, he gave us an important piece of information.
introDialogue.autoPresent: Point out the important information Anton gave.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: In the haunted house, he needed to make sure he was always standing behind all the visitors, while also keeping an eye on Victor and Sunny to see if they were trying to steal anything. So he stayed alert to the positions of himself and the others the whole time.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: From Spot 2 on, he kept checking his surroundings, making sure every visitor and performer was in sight. But as he got close to Spot 6, he realized there was someone else behind him.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Disappearing before Spot 2's performance ended, then showing up again at Spot 6... that doesn't sound like something a normal visitor would do. That person might have been the one who killed Victor during the show!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: And during the investigation, we found that someone had faked their alibi. That person was...

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: How did she fake her alibi?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: She used this...

choices.question: What did Orchid Ru use to fabricate her alibi?

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: But how can we confirm this had something to do with the movie that night?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Because of this one key detail.
introDialogue.autoPresent: Point out the evidence that Orchid Ru fabricated her alibi.

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That does not seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The ticket checker said they remembered Orchid Ru because she left midway through and went to the restroom for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: That sounds fine. Orchid Ru bought a ticket for the 18:30 screening, and after the Pumpkin King stole the magic wand—about 40 minutes into the film—she temporarily left the theater and was seen by the ticket checker.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: She was gone for a while, sure—but ten or fifteen minutes would barely be enough for a one-way cab ride from the cinema to the haunted house.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: She couldn't have killed Victor in just ten or fifteen minutes.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: But I did find a contradiction in what the ticket checker said.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The problem is...

choices.question: What is the real contradiction in the ticket checker's testimony?

options.text: A There were many moviegoers that night
B She re-entered only after more than ten minutes
options.reply: A dozen minutes is too short to make a round trip to the park.

options.text: C The lobby happened to be nearly empty at the time

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Even if the holiday crowd was big, the lobby wouldn't be packed all the time, right? So what's wrong with what she said?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Exactly. The problem is—if Orchid really watched the 18:30 show like she said, the lobby couldn't have been "nearly empty."

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: What?!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: This evidence can prove...
dialogue.autoPresent: Point out the evidence proving the lobby could not have been nearly empty.

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That does not seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: According to that night's schedule, if Orchid came out 40 minutes into her movie, she definitely would have run into the audience for another movie.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The audience she would have run into came for...

choices.question: Which movie would have had viewers entering one after another around 19:10?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The film "Autumn Letter" had a 19:15 screening. If Orchid Ru came out at 19:10, she would have run right into moviegoers entering one after another. The ticket checker would not have remembered it as "the lobby was nearly empty."

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: So Orchid might have bought two tickets? She actually watched a different screening?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Bingo!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Of all the screenings of "Halloween Wonder Night" that evening, how many could produce a situation where the lobby was empty 40 minutes after the film started?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The number of screenings that could lead to that scenario is...

choices.question: How many screenings could lead to that situation?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: After accounting for all the entry and exit times, the only screening that would create that situation is the 19:40 one.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Then if we work backward from the time of death... the killer could've finished everything by 19:15 at the latest, then gone to the 19:40 movie. There'd be plenty of time!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Exactly!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: So Orchid faked an alibi and had time to commit the crime—but that still doesn't prove she's the killer, does it? Why would she kill her own boyfriend?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: That brings us to a key issue: motive for murder. In fact, Orchid Ru did have a motive, because she was not only Victor Jiang's girlfriend. She had another identity as well. That identity was...
dialogue.autoPresent: Point out Orchid Ru's other identity

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That doesn't seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: This name... Daniel Xiao's fiancée? Why would you think Orchid Ru is Lynn Zhao?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Because something someone said earlier kept bugging me. And now it finally clicked.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: That statement was...
dialogue.autoPresent: Point out the statement that caught your attention

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That doesn't seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I once asked Sunny about Daniel's fiancée. Sunny said that girl often had to go to the hospital for injections.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Injections... Isn't that perfectly normal?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Usually, when people are sick, they say they go to the hospital to see a doctor or pick up medicine. Why would he specifically mention injections?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: It wasn't until I saw this information that I understood why it was 'injections.'

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: That information was...
dialogue.autoPresent: Point out the information that bothered you

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That doesn't seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: You mean...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What caught my attention was...

choices.question: What information about Orchid Ru caught your attention?

options.reply: Why? Are you saying people need injections once they reach a certain age...?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Her job. Orchid works at an animal rescue center. That kind of work means she's at constant risk of scratches and bites—so she'd need regular rabies and tetanus shots.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Ah...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: That's why I figured out that before she became Victor's girlfriend, Orchid was actually Lynn—Daniel's fiancée!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: If that's the case... then the motive was revenge for Daniel, who died three years ago... But why now...?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: We can ask her about that later. But there's someone else who might help us see more sides of the story.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: You mean there may be someone else who knows about this?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Yes. Don't you think this person's behavior around the time Victor was killed was strange?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The person acting strangely was...
dialogue.autoPresent: Point out who was acting strangely

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That doesn't seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: You mean the matter of Faye Liu lying?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Yes. The police confirmed Faye did take the train to Hexi City—but why would she ask her mom to lie and say she was hospitalized?

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Why?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The reason Faye lied was probably...

options.text: A She and the culprit were accomplices
options.reply: Her behavior seemed more like fear and avoidance.

options.text: B. She was worried she would be treated as the killer
options.reply: She has a solid alibi, so it would be hard to identify her as the killer.

options.text: C. She had anticipated Victor's death

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Faye probably knew something was going to happen during those days. That's why she didn't even dare answer the phone when it happened.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: How would Faye know about that?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Because Faye and Orchid—I mean Lynn—had actually been in touch all along. And this evidence proves it!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The evidence proving a connection between Faye and Orchid is...
dialogue.autoPresent: Please point out the evidence that proves a connection between Faye and Orchid.

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That doesn't seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Inside Faye's locker, there was a cat-head volunteer badge with the word 'Sweet' on it. Sweet and cats—does that remind you of anything?

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Sweet... cats...? Ah! I got it!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Yes, that word feels familiar, doesn't it?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Where did a similar word appear...?
dialogue.autoPresent: Please point out where you saw a similar word.

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That doesn't seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Orchid works at Sweet Meow Animal Rescue Center!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Exactly! I bet if we check, the rescue center must have given out those volunteer badges.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: But why would the two of them know each other? People closer to Victor didn't know Orchid Ru, his girlfriend, so why would Faye know her?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: They probably met through this person...
dialogue.autoPresent: Please point out who introduced them to each other.

wrongReply.speaker: char_xiaozhi
wrongReply.t: That doesn't seem to be it...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: They didn't meet only recently. It was because of Daniel — Lynn Zhao's fiancé, the man who died three years ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: So... Faye knew all along that Orchid was Lynn—maybe she even knew Orchid's real reason for getting close to Victor...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The clues are pretty clear now, but I still think we need to talk to Faye and Lynn directly and confirm our deductions.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Alright. Take a short break—I'll bring Faye and Lynn in for the final round.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: October 31, 2025, 4:30 PM, Chaoye Park, Visitor Center

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Faye walked nervously into the interrogation area. You told Faye your deductions. She stayed silent for a long time before finally revealing the truth.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: You're right. Orchid is Daniel's fiancée, Lynn Zhao.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: Daniel and I joined the park at the same time, and we were assigned to the same group, so we were always close.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: When Daniel was still alive, the four of us—Daniel, Lynn, me, and my boyfriend back then—used to do pet rescue work together. We had some really good times.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: Later, Daniel died. I was also deeply saddened. Before he died, Daniel would sometimes tell me how stressed the haunted house rehearsals were, how his old injury was acting up again, and how Victor kept making him do these flashy moves he thought were pointless.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: So I suspected Daniel's death might not have been what they claimed. But since I hadn't seen it myself, I couldn't say for sure. I couldn't give her any answers.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: We still met and messaged each other from time to time. When I broke up with my boyfriend, Lynn was the one who stayed with me through that hardest period. The float parade accident last year... I told Lynn about that too.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: About a year ago, I noticed Lynn had changed completely—her hair, makeup, clothes... everything was different. And she was especially interested in this year's show.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: She asked me to give her a tour of the haunted house. She went through every hidden door, checked every prop, asked about every detail of the show—the choreography, the timing, the costumes—even asked for rehearsal footage.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: After Daniel died, that was the first time she had actively wanted to learn about anything related to that project. And so much time had already passed since then. Why was she suddenly so concerned?

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: I really couldn't understand it at the time. Until I discovered something very strange.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: Lynn was dating Victor.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: I didn't mean to see it... When she sent a string of hearts, I saw the profile picture that flashed by. It was Victor.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: I asked her right then why things had turned out this way, and why it had to be Victor. She said she'd changed her name to Orchid Ru, and that I should stop calling her Lynn and never mention Daniel again.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: I was really worried. I knew how much Lynn had loved Daniel—this was way too strange... I had a bad feeling something terrible was going to happen.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: At that time, she seemed to be asking Victor about something. Probably about Daniel... and sometimes even about me.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: She asked me to look into the real cause of the accident back then, saying things might not be the way I thought... After I found out, I was shocked and asked her how she knew.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: She said it was time to settle the score.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: Those few days, I had a really bad feeling... She messaged me and told me not to be afraid if anything bad came up...

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: I was so panicked that I took two days off... I just wanted to get away from this place, even for a little while.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: After I went home, I told Mom I was exhausted and wanted to rest, but the park would not let me leave, so I could only lie and say Mom was sick. Mom said that if anyone called to ask, she would say exactly what I told her to.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: I didn't dare pick up the phone for two days. I stayed with my mom the whole time—only being with her could quiet the thoughts in my head.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: Later, just as expected, Victor died. I was the only person who knew the truth.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: I thought about calling the police—but I couldn't make up my mind. I absolutely did not approve of what Lynn did, but I also couldn't bring myself to send her to prison.

dialogue.speaker: char_meiyu
dialogue.t: Was I wrong? By telling you all this... have I betrayed Lynn and Daniel?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: October 31, 2025, 7:42 PM, Chaoye Amusement Park, Visitor Center

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You explained the situation to Officer Qin. Qin said she would arrest Orchid for murder later. But for now, you can talk to her a little more.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The moment you walk into the questioning area, Orchid raises her eyes to look at you. She is scanning your expression.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: She seems to read it. She sighs, her eyes and brows drooping, as if a mask has fallen from her face.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Orchid Ru, or rather, Lynn Zhao. We already know what you did.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Mm. Was it Faye who told you?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: No. Even when we suspected her, she was too scared to say anything—she didn't give you up. Your alibi is what gave you away.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Ah... is that so.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: She pretends to be calm. But the tears welling up in her eyes betray her.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Faye is such a kind soul.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: All right... what have you deduced?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You believed there was more to Daniel's death. You turned yourself into another person and approached Victor Jiang, a key figure in the haunted house team. You pretended to be in love with him, trying to make him reveal the truth about what happened three years ago. After getting the information you wanted, you began your revenge plan, and in the end, you killed him at the place where Daniel died.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Then how did I do it?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You pretended to be a visitor and blended into the crowd. Then...

options.reply: That would be a bit difficult...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You followed Victor to Spot 5 and strangled him.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I'm not strong enough to directly strangle an adult man. If he fought back, I would be subdued.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You used something that was relatively easy to obtain at work...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You used anesthetic from the rescue center to knock him out, then strangled him. You hid the body in the corner, put on the Red Death robe and mask yourself, and danced the duet with Sunny.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: That was the first time I'd ever danced in front of an audience. The first time I tried to understand what Daniel used to do.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I deliberately wore my highest heels to make myself look about Victor's height. Dancing in heels was hard—even just holding someone's hand and turning was tough.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: While I was dancing, an absurd image kept playing in my mind: my heel stepping on the robe, and as I spun, the robe and mask being pulled off together.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Sunny would immediately realize I was not Victor, and she would become suspicious. Then she would see the body in the corner, scream, and draw all the actors and visitors over. They would look at me as if they were looking at the plague itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: The sound of police cars would ring out, and red and blue lights would even shine deep into the haunted house.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: A cold metal around my wrists, and then I would sit in the car and leave that place filled with sorrow and resentment under everyone's astonished gazes.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: But none of that happened in the end.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Everything went off without a hitch.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Then I followed behind the other visitors, left through the exit, and was not stopped at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Then I went to watch that movie... My heart kept pounding out of control, my fingers cramped, and my stomach felt as if it were burning... But I had to force myself to remember the plot of the movie... If anyone asked, I could not say I did not know.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Partway through the screening, I felt nauseous, so... when the ticket checker saw me going to the restroom, it wasn't part of my plan... I truly felt awful. It took me a long time to recover before I returned to the screening room.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I went back to my seat and waited forever for the movie to end. Then I fled and went home.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: These past two days, I feel like I've been living in a haze—I can barely tell dreams from reality anymore. In my dreams, sometimes Daniel is lying beside me, and sometimes Victor is. When I wake up, there are occasional moments when I feel that the two of them might still be alive, living in some corner of the world I cannot find.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Then I came here and had to lie to you. I had to act like an innocent victim.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You said nothing. You felt Orchid needed a moment to calm down. After a long while, you raised your own question again.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What state of mind were you living in beside Victor?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I approached him with the idea of learning the truth. But I never found a chance to ask about it in depth. Every time I tested him, he brushed it off.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: At the same time, I could feel that things were not going well for him at the park. He began often going out drinking with others.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Sometimes when he was drunk, he would call me his wife. He would say, honey, let's live properly together from now on. He would treat me well.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I began to feel that maybe continuing on like this would be fine? Daniel was already gone, and the person in front of me gave me real companionship. He cooked for me, took out the trash on his way downstairs, and helped dry my hair after I showered.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Those real, tangible moments of warmth left me a little dazed.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: When that thought hit me, I was shocked at myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Had I forgotten why I got close to him in the first place? Am I really that weak—that easily swayed?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Your guess just now was not completely right. You said I was pretending to be in love with him while planning revenge, but that was not actually true. I was wavering the whole time.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Before that, something else happened. Faye messaged me and said she had caused a serious accident and nearly lost her job, but Victor helped cover it up for her. She said she felt Victor probably was not a bad person.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: That incident reinforced my impression of Victor's good side... I even started to wonder whether I still needed to keep pressing for answers like this.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Until one day, he got drunk and began saying things he normally would not say...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: He said... those stupid colleagues were all brainless trash. He'd tricked a female coworker into thinking she'd caused the battery to break, and she actually bought it—walking around terrified every day. Hilarious, he said.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: And what about the actor who killed himself before? I hurriedly asked him: that actor who killed himself, was he also a stupid person?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Victor said... he was the most useless one of all... He could not even fasten a safety buckle properly, deserved to become a a noose-dangler, and even dragged others into his bad luck...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: You should have seen the smug look on his face—it made me sick. He said, "I unfastened that unlucky bastard's safety buckle, had someone put the rope around his neck and hoist him back up, and told everyone he'd hanged himself."

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: He said he hadn't even needed to lift a finger himself, yet he completely turned the whole situation around. After doing that, not only was he not punished, but he also used the incident to get rid of the department supervisor he had always disliked.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: As Orchid spoke, her expression grew increasingly furious.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: That's when I finally saw him for who he really was. All those months of confusion and hesitation vanished in that moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: There was not a trace of guilt in his words, only boasting about how clever he thought he had been.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: That was the real him. A disgusting, petty, unrepentant coward.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: That was the first moment I truly wanted to kill him.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: He had to die.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Later, I reached out to Faye again and started putting my plan into motion.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: On the day of the show, I covered my face with a hat and mask, went in, drugged him, and strangled him. After dancing with Sunny, I changed into the non-slip shoes I'd prepared, wrapped Victor in the Red Death robe, dragged him under the table, then pulled the robe off and tossed it back at Spot 5.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: It went unbelievably smoothly. Especially the moment I called his name in that dark, noisy room.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I understand. In the plan you just described, there was one crucial uncertainty.

options.reply: The robe was large enough to hide my figure...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: It was the mask. It didn't seal properly against his face. So even if the victim kept it on, it would be hard for you to render him unconscious with an anesthetic-soaked towel, since the gas wouldn't be contained.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Yes. So I called his name. I said, Victor, it's me. I'm here to see you.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: He stared at me in disbelief at first, then he stepped closer. I took off his mask.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Even as he was losing consciousness, he still had that look of disbelief on his face.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: But I think in the end, he understood what that room and that rope stood for.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Orchid Ru closed her eyes, as if recalling Victor's expression in his final moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: The greatest uncertainty in this whole thing actually came from Faye. If she had revealed my identity, you would have found me much faster, and I never would have had a chance to escape punishment.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: She did not say anything, but you still reasoned out the truth.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: My story is over. Now you can take me away.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: October 31, 2025, 8:22 PM, Chaoye Park, in front of the haunted house

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Officer Qin took Orchid Ru out of the park. There was none of the surreal scene she had imagined, with red and blue lights flashing in the darkness, no shocked crowd watching and staring. Under cover of night, the police car slipped silently toward the depths like a dark fish.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Faye stood to the side, covering her face as she cried. Soon, she seemed unable to sit still any longer and rushed into the night as well.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Everyone had yet to recover from the shock. Suddenly, the pickpocket Anton Han slunk up to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Um... Miss Detective?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Hm?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: You were... totally awesome!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Ahaha...

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: To tell you the truth... even though I may look like this... I've always wanted to be a detective!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I thought you wanted to be the greatest phantom thief of all time?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Yeah, but being a famous phantom thief makes you an easy target for the cops.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: So you do know that?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Yes! I also know that Sherlock Holmes and Arsène Lupin were good friends!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Who told you that? They were rivals—rivals!

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Maybe Lupin also dreamed of being Holmes!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Could you please not arbitrarily rewrite the world classics?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: So, Miss Detective, do you need a phantom thief friend?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Silence means consent! I'll take that as a yes!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I'm thinking about asking Officer Qin to lock you up for a few days...

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Oh please don't... Miss Detective is so cruel...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Before I change my mind, you have three seconds to get out of my sight.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Waaahhh...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Anton let out a strange cry and ran off. What an odd thief.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Ahem.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Sis, how'd I do today as your assistant?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Absolutely amazing! My precious little sister is the best assistant in the whole world!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Of course I am. So, Sis, don't just let any thief tag along, okay?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Wait — what?

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: I heard everything! That thief kept insisting he wanted to be your assistant!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I did not agree to that!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Good! I'm all the assistant you need, Sis!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Okay, okay. Come on, let's grab some late-night food—my treat!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Yay!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: And so, the Chaoye Park case came to an end in all that chaos.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What bizarre cases might be waiting for you next?

dialogue.t: You have now reached the end of the The Uncovering demo.
